# Wolf Hair Restoration

> Doctor-led hair restoration clinic in Cincinnati, Ohio. Board-certified surgeons performing FUE, FUT, and ARTAS robotic hair transplants, plus PRP and Keralase. Natural-looking results, interest-free financing, and a free consultation.

## Business facts (NAP)
- Name: Wolf Hair Restoration
- Address: 11877 Mason Montgomery Rd., Suite A, Cincinnati, OH 45249, USA
- Phone: 513-774-0400
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM
- Service area: Greater Cincinnati, including Mason, West Chester, Blue Ash, and Hamilton, plus Dayton, Columbus, and Northern Kentucky.

## Doctors
- Dr. Bradley Wolf, MD, FISHRS: Founder and lead surgeon. ABHRS board-certified, Past President of the International Society of Hair Restoration Surgery (ISHRS), treating since 1990.
- Dr. Scott Welden, MD: Medical Director. Board-certified physician with more than 20 years of experience, ISHRS member, trained under Dr. Wolf.

## Procedures
- FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction): individual grafts, no linear scar, fast recovery.
- FUT (Follicular Unit Transplantation): strip method, maximum grafts in one session.
- ARTAS robotic: FDA-cleared robotic assistance for precise follicle harvesting.
- PRP therapy: platelet-rich plasma to support existing follicles.
- Keralase: laser plus topical hair-growth serum.

## Pricing
- Entry package from $2,990 for eligible candidates.
- Interest-free financing available.
- Free consultation; exact pricing depends on graft count and is confirmed at consultation.

- ARTAS is FDA-cleared (510k device), not FDA-approved.
